main_text.p: הַשּׁוּכָא חֲשׁוּךְ Ch. Tenebrae, Obscuritas, obtenebratio, Tenebricosus, caliginosus locus: Plur. חֲשׁוּכִין, חֲשׁוּכַיָא.
ܚܫܘܟܐ Syr. Idem: Item Tenebrosus, tenebricosus.
ܚܫܟ Vide paulò ante in חשב.
ܚܫܟܐ Syr. Idem. Constr. ܐܬܚܫܟ Et tenebrae erant, Johan.6.17. vel potius est tertia persona fœmin. Verbi, cujus cōstructio cum substantivo verbo est frequens.
חֲשׁוּכָא & חֲשׁוּךְ, חֲשִׁיכָא Ch. Obscurus, pauper, egenus, tenuis, inops. Plur. חֲשִׁיכִין, חֲשִׁיכַיָא. Fœm. חֲשִׁיכְתָּא Paupercula. Plur. חֲשִׁיכָתָא, חֲשִׁיכָן.
מַחְשִׁיךְ Ch. Idem. Plur. מַחְשִׁיכֵי עַמָּא Et tenues populi, Jerem.40.7.
* חֲשַׁךְ Idem quod חֲסַךְ. Vide illic.
חשל Ch. Debilitare, infirmare, Daniel.2.40. Item Cogitare, Excogitare, Moliri, Machinari, Comminisci.
ܚܫܠܐ Syr. Bracteolae extenuatae, 1.Petr.3.3. In Reg. Additamenta. Tremel. Excogitatione auri.
נַחְשׁוּלָא Ch. Tempestas. Plur. נַחְשׁוּלִין, נַחְשׁוּלַיָא.
חשם ܚܫܡ Syr. Coenare. Aphel ܐܚܫܡ Idem, Lucae

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are reproduced approximately from the scan; several Syriac and vocalised forms are doubtful and the transcription of those lines is not certain. Right-hand margin is empty.
